findings: Store trees. Yandex Lavka Uzbekistan (the only big grocer whose catalog loads without an app; 55 categories, 3,414 SKUs pulled): Ovoshchi/frukty/zelen, Moloko-maslo-yaytsa, Kefir-smetana-tvorog, Syry, Myaso-ptitsa-ryba, Kolbasa i sosiski, Bulochnaya/Khleb, Makarony-krupy-muka, Maslo-sousy-spetsii, Konservy, Chay, Kofe i kakao, Shokolad i konfety, Torty-pechenye-vafli, Snaki, Sukhofrukty-orekhi i kurt (qurt sits with the dried fruit and nuts, not with dairy), Voda i napitki, Zamorozka (pelmeni, vareniki), Morozhenoe, Gotovaya eda (somsa, qatlama), Dlya detey. Lavka also sells local items by their Uzbek names: kurt, katyk, kaymak, suzma, ayran, kazy, katlama, somsa. Makro's Uzbek API titles show the store vocabulary in Uzbek: sut, qatiq, qaymoq, smetana, sariyog', sharbat, nektar, bo'tqa, pyure, pechenye, chips, mayonez, margarin, sizes written as '0,5 l', '190 g', '20 dona'. Korzinka (403) and Uzum (sign-in) block bots, so they were not read; Havas shows only its weekly offers. By weight: everything from the bazaar (dehqon bozori): fruit, vegetables, meat and offal, poultry, fish, rice (devzira, lazer, alanga, chungara, nukus), legumes (mosh, no'xat, loviya), loose flour and sugar, dried fruit (mayiz kinds: soyaki, sabza, kishmish; o'rik: kuraga, bargak, turshak), nuts, seeds, spices, qurt, loose sweets (konfet, novvot, parvarda, holva), pechenye and pryanik, pickles and Korean salads, kolbasa and cheese at the deli counter, uy suzmasi/qaymog'i/tvorogi, chuchvara and pelmen by weight. Prices of meat, fruit, vegetables and grain are per kg; spices, dried fruit, nuts, konfet, qurt and pista are usually quoted per 100 g (so step_g 100); kolbasa and cheese per kg, cut from 200-300 g. Greens are sold per bog' (bunch). By piece: bread (obi non, patir, tandir non), somsa, eggs (by dona, ten, or a 30-egg tray, with categories C0/C1/C2), all packaged goods. Market statistics (stat.uz, yuz.uz) quote eggs per 10 dona, oil per litre, rice and sugar per kg. Typical packs: milk/kefir/qatiq 0,5 l, 0,9 l, 1 l; smetana 200/400 g; tvorog 180-200 g; sariyog' 180-200 g; paxta yog'i 1 l and 5 l; rice 0,9-1 kg and 25/50 kg sacks; flour 1/2/5/10 kg and 50 kg sacks; water 0,5/1/1,5/5/10 l and 19-20 l bottles; soda 0,5/1/1,5/2 l; juice 0,2 l and 1 l; mayonnaise 200/400/800 g; tushonka 325-338 g; tea 100/200 g or 25/100 bags (green tea numbers 95 and 110); chips 28-150 g. Water 19/20 l carries a bottle deposit. Many brands are local (Musaffo, Pure Milky, Essi, Kamilka, Sherin, Rozmetov, To'xtaniyoz Ota, UzRice, Milter, Bliss, Hydrolife, Chortoq).
